_doc: Feature-flag registry. Runtime source of truth is the KV key 'feature_flags' (instant change, no redeploy); this file is the reviewed default/seed AND the governance registry. Hygiene is enforced by tests/test_flags_hygiene.js (run by make test): every flag needs type+owner+description; release/experiment flags need a future 'expires'; expired flags fail CI to force cleanup. See docs/27-feature-flag-workflow.md.

_types.release: short-lived; gates a risky change during rollout, then removed. MUST expire.
_types.ops: long-lived kill switch / circuit breaker. May omit 'expires'.

example-new-funeral-layout.description: Template flag — replace with a real one. Shows the required shape; not wired into the edge yet.
